_doc: Oathwild's quests (world builder 2026-11-23). js/world/quests.js is the one reader. Progress belongs to the shared world; each player collects the reward once from `turnIn` (also a player who joins later). `level` = the level the quest is made for; it can be taken from `minLevel` (default level - 2). Step kinds: talk (npc, say, options = a story choice: `flag` sets a world flag, `personalFlag` one for the chooser), kill (targets: monster id and/or camp, count, label; kills by anyone in the world count once the quest is started), collect (objects = quest containers in data/placements.json `objects`; taking the quest item from each counts), use (objects to use), reach (place in data/map.json), escort (npc follows the nearest hero to place `to`). `worldFlags` on a step or in rewards are set for everyone. Rewards: xp, gold, items / pick (Emberveil base keys, made at the quest level), flags (personal, e.g. the pact or a class contract), byChoice (parts swapped by the choice the group made). XP sizing (Guessed): side quests 30 + 22 x level, main quests 45 + 30 x level, so quests give about half of the XP from level 1 to 10 and kills the rest (tests/world/bot.test.mjs measures it).

silent_bell.title: The Silent Bell
silent_bell.summary: The shrine bell of Larkford cracked in the night, all by itself. Brother Tobin is worried.
offer: Last night the shrine bell rang once, loud as thunder, and then cracked from lip to crown.
Brother Tobin has not slept since. Would you look in on him? He listens to strangers better than to me.
silent_bell.acceptReply: Thank you. The shrine is just across the square, by the old oak.

steps.text: Speak with Brother Tobin at the Brightwater Shrine.
steps.ask: The elder sent me about the bell.
say: Ah, the elder sent you. Good. Look at the bell yourself, would you? Tell me what you see.

steps.text: Look closely at the cracked shrine bell.

done: Ash in the crack, you say? Grey ash, from a flame that should never go out.
Then the Old Hill Shrine has gone dark. Someone put it out. And that, friend, is a very bad sign.

tracks_by_the_river.title: Tracks by the River
tracks_by_the_river.summary: Someone has been carrying shrine candles away along the river at night.
offer: The shrine's candle chest is half empty, and there were wet footprints on the floor.
Fisher Wynn says lights move along Lantern Reach at night. Will you look there, and take what you find to Captain Brandt?
tracks_by_the_river.acceptReply: Follow the river south from the bridge. Lantern Reach is the shallow bend.

steps.text: Search Lantern Reach, south of Larkford along the river.
Find what the night visitors dropped.

done: A wooden token with a hollow mouth carved in it. The Hollow Choir.
They are a story mothers tell. A choir that sings the lights out. Apparently they are also real.

the_ford_road.title: The Ford Road
the_ford_road.summary: The bandits at the ford sell to anyone. Their chief keeps a ledger.
offer: The bandits at the ford have been selling to the Choir. Candles, rope, lamp oil.
Their chief writes everything down. He cannot help himself. Bring me that ledger, and bring the chief down.
the_ford_road.acceptReply: Take the Ford Road south. Go with friends if you have them.

steps.text: Defeat the Bandit Chief at the camp by the ford.
Take the chief's ledger from his tent.

done: Forty candles, two barrels of oil... and a name. 'The Speaker, at the Old Hill.'
So that is where they sing. Thank you. The vale owes you.

the_hollow_choir.title: The Hollow Choir
the_hollow_choir.summary: The Choir's Speaker holds the Old Hill Shrine. Break the Choir and light the flame again.
offer: The Old Hill Shrine. Their Speaker is there, singing the flame out.
Climb the Old Hill Path, break the Choir, and light the shrine again. Then go to the elder. She will want to hear it from you.
the_hollow_choir.acceptReply: The path starts south of the village, past the fields. Touch the waystone at the bottom of the hill first.

steps.text: Reach the Old Hill Waystone at the foot of the hill.
Silence the Hollow Choir Speaker at the hilltop shrine.
Light the Old Hill Shrine's flame again.

done: The flame is lit? I felt it, I think. Like a window opening in winter.
But the Speaker said something before the end, didn't they? 'The King under the Thornmere is waking.' The ranger-captain at Thornwatch must hear of this.

through_the_gate.title: Through the Thornmere Gate
through_the_gate.summary: Carry the Speaker's warning east, through the gap in the Thornback Ridge, to Thornwatch.
offer: Follow the Lark Road east, through the Thornmere Gate. Ranger-Captain Fen Asher keeps the lodge at Thornwatch.
The Wilds are older than the vale, and less polite. Touch the gate shrine on the way, so it knows you.
through_the_gate.acceptReply: Go well. Larkford will keep a light for you.

steps.text: Pass the Thornmere Gate and touch its shrine.
Find Ranger-Captain Fen Asher at Thornwatch.
say: A king under the Thornmere? There is only one, and he is supposed to be very, very dead.

done: The Barrow King swore the first oath to guard the vale, long ago, and broke it. The druids bound him for it.
If he is waking, the druids will know why. Welcome to Thornwatch. Mind the mud.

words_of_the_grove.title: Words of the Grove
words_of_the_grove.summary: Ask the druids how the Barrow King was bound, and how to bind him again.
offer: Take the Grove Trail north to the Druid Circle. Archdruid Teodor is older than my lodge and twice as stubborn.
Ask him how the King was bound. And be polite to the trees.
words_of_the_grove.acceptReply: North along the Grove Trail. You cannot miss the stones.

steps.text: Speak with Archdruid Teodor at the Druid Circle.
steps.ask: Fen Asher sent me about the Barrow King.
say: So the old oathbreaker stirs. The binding was written on a tablet of heartwood. It lies in the circle's altar.

steps.text: Take the heartwood tablet from the circle's altar.

done: Three seal-stones ring the barrow. Lit, they hold him. Someone has let them go dark.
Light them again, and he will be weaker when you face him. And you will face him, I think.

seal_stones.title: The Seal-Stones
seal_stones.summary: Light the three seal-stones around the Undead Barrow and thin out its guards.
offer: Follow the Barrow Road east over the Old Stone Bridge. The three seal-stones stand on the downs round the barrow.
The dead guard them. Put some of them back to sleep, and light the stones.
seal_stones.acceptReply: Touch the Barrow Watch shrine on the way. You may need it.

steps.text: Defeat skeleton warriors on the Barrow Downs.
Light the three seal-stones around the barrow.

done: I felt them catch, one, two, three. The King will feel it too. He is weaker now, and angry.
Rest, mend your gear, and gather your friends. Then go down into the dark.

the_barrow_king.title: The Barrow King
the_barrow_king.summary: Defeat the oathbreaker in his barrow and bring his crown to Thornwatch.
offer: He sits on his stone throne with his crown on his knees, waiting for the seals to fail.
End him. Bring the crown to Fen Asher; it must not stay in the dark.
the_barrow_king.acceptReply: The barrow's mouth faces the morning. Go in together if you can.

steps.text: Defeat the Barrow King.
Take the Barrow King's crown from his throne.

done: So that is the crown that started it all. Look, here, under the rim: a star with four points, and a word. 'Frostreach.'
He did not swear alone. There were four oaths, sworn in four places. The others are north, past the snows. That is a road for another day.

wolves_at_the_fold.title: Wolves at the Fold
wolves_at_the_fold.summary: Wolves from the Hartwood keep taking Ada Fenn's lambs.
offer: Three lambs this month. The wolves come out of the Hartwood bold as anything.
Thin the pack for me? Six should teach the rest some manners.
wolves_at_the_fold.acceptReply: They lope along the wood's edge, north of the fold.

steps.text: Hunt Vale Wolves at the edge of the Hartwood.

done: Six! My lambs thank you, and so do I. Here, it is not much, but it is honest.

pip_in_the_hartwood.title: Pip in the Hartwood
pip_in_the_hartwood.summary: Della's boy went to look at the wolves. Bring him home.
offer: My Pip went off to 'see a wolf up close'. He is seven.
He will be at the edge of the Hartwood, north-east, scared stiff and pretending not to be. Bring him home?
pip_in_the_hartwood.acceptReply: Thank you. Tell him there is pie. That usually works.

steps.ask: There is pie at home, Pip.
say: Pie? ...All right. But you go first. In case of wolves.
steps.text: Find Pip at the Hartwood's edge and walk him home to Larkford.

done: Pip! Oh, you muddy little - thank you. Thank you so much.

the_millers_sacks.title: The Miller's Sacks
the_millers_sacks.summary: Three sacks of flour went missing from the mill. They turned up somewhere strange.
offer: Three sacks of good flour, gone in the night! Thieves, I say.
Find them for me. I hear things are odd in Tansy's Field lately. The scarecrows have been... wandering.
the_millers_sacks.acceptReply: Tansy's Field is south of the village, by the river.

steps.text: Recover the three flour sacks from Tansy's Field.
The sacks are stitched with Widow Perrin's mark. Ask her about it.
steps.ask: Why are these sacks stitched with your mark?
say: Oh. Oh dear. I sewed those for Hobb, years ago. I... asked the scarecrow-man to bring me one. Just one. The children were hungry.
I did not think he would bring three. Or that the scarecrows would walk.

options.text: Keep one sack. I will tell Hobb it was the scarecrows.
reply: Bless you. I will pay him back in cloth, I promise.

options.text: These go back to the mill. Talk to Hobb yourself.
reply: ...Yes. Yes, you are right. I will go and see him.

done: Two sacks? One got 'eaten by scarecrows'? ...Never mind. Two is better than none.

the_runaway_mare.title: The Runaway Mare
the_runaway_mare.summary: Corwin's best mare bolted in the storm and will not come home.
offer: Chestnut bolted in last night's storm. She is out by Watch Knoll, I think, too frightened to come home.
She knows the smell of apples. Calm her down, and she will follow her nose back.
the_runaway_mare.acceptReply: Watch Knoll is east, past the bridge. Take an apple. Take two.

steps.text: Calm Chestnut the mare near Watch Knoll.

done: She came trotting in with her tail up like nothing happened. Horses!
From now on, you get the friend price on any horse in my stable.

wanted_rook_varrow.title: Wanted: Rook Varrow
wanted_rook_varrow.summary: A poacher and pickpocket with a price on his head hides north-east of the village.
offer: See the wanted board? Rook Varrow. Poacher, pickpocket, and very rude.
He hides past the Poacher's Path, north-east of the bridge. Bring him in, or at least stop him.
wanted_rook_varrow.acceptReply: He fights dirty. Watch his knives.

steps.text: Stop Rook Varrow at his hideout.

done: That is one name off the board. The bounty is yours, fair and square.

lights_on_the_water.title: Lights on the Water
lights_on_the_water.summary: Not every light on the river belongs to the Choir. Someone else is hiding something at Lantern Reach.
offer: The Choir's lights stopped, but another one still bobs on the water some nights. A small one. Sneaky.
There is a hollow under the old willow at Lantern Reach. I am too old to crawl in there. Would you?
lights_on_the_water.acceptReply: Under the willow, on the bank. Quietly, now.

steps.text: Search the hollow under the willow at Lantern Reach.
The bundle holds bottles marked with the inn's brand. Ask Josse Amberley.
steps.ask: These bottles have your brand on them.
say: Ah. Yes. Cider from over the ridge. The tax on it is... very large. I bring it in by boat, at night.
I have done no harm! But you could tell the captain, I suppose.

reply: ...Fair. I will go and pay what I owe. Tomorrow. Today. Today.

options.text: Your secret is safe. Pour me a cup sometime.
reply: A friend for life! And a cup, whenever you like.

done: Josse? The innkeeper? Ha! So that is the little light. Thank you for settling my nerves.

goblin_trouble.title: Goblin Trouble
goblin_trouble.summary: The goblins of the Gobbet Hills are raiding the north fields.
offer: Goblins in the Gobbet Hills, north-west. They raid the north fields for turnips. Turnips!
Their warchief has grown bold. Clear the warren and bring the warchief down.
goblin_trouble.acceptReply: Follow the North Track to its end. You will hear them before you see them.

steps.text: Clear the Goblin Warren and defeat its warchief.

done: The north fields can keep their turnips. Well done.

items.label: a goblin-made buckler (it is better than it looks)

the_grove_trial.title: The Grove Trial
the_grove_trial.summary: A blight has taken a grove south of the circle. Clear it and wake the spirit pools, and the grove will trust you.
offer: A grove south of here has gone sour. Thornlings and root-callers, twisted by something.
Clear the blight and wake the two spirit pools beside it. Do it, and the grove will trust you. Warden Ysolde teaches only those the grove trusts.
the_grove_trial.acceptReply: The Blighted Grove lies along the trail, between here and Thornwatch.

steps.text: Clear the blight from the Blighted Grove.
Wake the two spirit pools by the grove.

done: The grove breathes again. Warden Ysolde is waiting for you by the stones. She will teach Druids to call the wolf and the bear.

flagsText: Warden Ysolde comes to the Druid Circle

the_toll_bridge.title: The Toll Bridge
the_toll_bridge.summary: A troll has moved under the bridge on the Lark Road and charges a toll. In teeth.
offer: A troll took the bridge over the Mirewater. It asks a toll. If you cannot pay, it takes teeth.
Nobody gets to the mire or the east downs while it sits there. Move it. Permanently.
the_toll_bridge.acceptReply: East on the Lark Road. You will smell it first.

steps.text: Defeat the Bridge Troll.

done: The bridge is open! I owe you a drink, and the carters owe you a song.

bounty_old_scarback.title: Bounty: Old Scarback
bounty_old_scarback.summary: A huge, scarred bear has been savaging hunters in the Bearwood.
offer: Old Scarback. A bear bigger than a cart, with a scar from ear to tail.
He has torn up four hunters. I do not hate bears. I hate this one. His den is off the Bearwood Trail.
bounty_old_scarback.acceptReply: South on the Bearwood Trail. Do not let him get behind you.

steps.text: Hunt Old Scarback in his den.

done: Rest easy, old monster. And thank you, hunter.

a_voice_in_the_mire.title: A Voice in the Mire
a_voice_in_the_mire.summary: Travellers hear a voice from a black stone at the mire's western edge. It offers bargains.
offer: There is a black stone at the edge of the mire that talks. It offers deals to the curious.
Go and see. Do NOT promise it anything. ...You are going to promise it something, aren't you.
a_voice_in_the_mire.acceptReply: South on the Bearwood Trail, to its very end.

steps.text: Find the Black Stone at the end of the Bearwood Trail.
Listen to the voice in the stone.
say: I am Mother Sallow, little candle. Bound in this stone by the same druids who bound your Barrow King.
I can teach a mage the old bargains: hexes, a servant from below, a gate you pay for in blood. All I ask is a promise.

reply: Lovely. A drop of you, a drop of me. There. Come back when you know three spells, and we will begin.
Today. Ha! I am very patient. Come back whenever you like.

done: The stone hums to itself, pleased. Somewhere far off, a frog stops singing.

flagsText: The Warlock pact can be sealed at the Black Stone

lost_in_the_mire.title: Lost in the Mire
lost_in_the_mire.summary: Tamsin the herbalist went into the mire for herbs two days ago.
offer: Tamsin went into the mire for bog-lily two days ago. She always comes back in one.
Herb Hollow, along the Mire Way. Bring her to the Mire Shrine; she can find her way from there.
lost_in_the_mire.acceptReply: Take the Mire Way from the troll's bridge. Watch your step.

steps.ask: Follow me, I know the dry way.
say: Oh thank goodness. Lead on. I will be right behind you. Right behind. Do not walk fast.
steps.text: Find Tamsin at Herb Hollow and lead her to the Mire Shrine.

done: She is back, with a basket of bog-lily and a new fear of frogs. Thank you.

the_gravecutters_contract.title: The Gravecutter's Contract
the_gravecutters_contract.summary: A hooded stranger pays well for one quiet job: the orc raider Redtusk.
offer: Redtusk. Orc raider. Burns farms over the ridge and comes back here to count his loot.
I want him gone, quietly. Do this and I will show you the Gravecutter's ways - if you have the hands for it.
the_gravecutters_contract.acceptReply: His camp is off the Redtusk Trail, north of the Lark Road past the bridge.

steps.text: Remove Redtusk from his camp.

done: Clean work. Here is your fee. And your contract: show it to me again when you are ready to learn.

flagsText: A Gravecutter contract (opens the Gravecutter class for Rogues)

the_lost_tome.title: The Lost Tome
the_lost_tome.summary: Ilsabet's teacher left a tome in the Undead Barrow. She wants it back, and so might you.
offer: My teacher went into the barrow to study the dead and left his tome on a sarcophagus. He was not brave twice.
Fetch it? Read it first if you like. Everyone who reads it learns something about the dead.
the_lost_tome.acceptReply: The tome lies on a stone coffin just outside the barrow mouth.

steps.text: Take the tome from the sarcophagus at the barrow.

done: You read it, didn't you? Good. Mages who read it can learn the Necromancer's art from me.

items.label: the Barrow-Lantern Tome (a shadow tome that casts a column)

flagsText: The barrow tome (opens the Necromancer class for Mages)

the_drowned_ruins.title: The Drowned Ruins
the_drowned_ruins.summary: The Marsh Hag keeps a woodcutter in a cage in the Drowned Ruins.
offer: Tamsin saw a man in a cage in the Drowned Ruins. Odo, a woodcutter, missing a week.
The Marsh Hag keeps him for... I do not want to say. Get him out. Deal with her.
the_drowned_ruins.acceptReply: The Mire Way ends at the ruins. Bring friends. Bring all of them.

steps.text: Defeat the Marsh Hag in the Drowned Ruins.
Open Odo's cage.

done: Odo walked in an hour ago, soaked and singing. He says to tell you his axe is yours whenever you need firewood.
